title: Pure-section predicate for the tensor-complex Koszul symmetry
statement: Let $J$ be a topology on a category with object universe $c$ and morphism universe $v$, with module sheafification and locally bijective equivalences in universe $\max(c,v,u)$, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in that universe. Use its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and actual sheafified pure-tensor summand generators $\iota_{p,q}^n(x\otimes y)$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Write $\beta_{P,Q}:P\otimes_R Q\to Q\otimes_R P$ for the canonical cochain-complex braiding, the commutativity constraint of the symmetric monoidal category of module complexes with the total tensor, induced termwise by the symmetry of the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define the signed-pure-section property of this braiding to be the following proposition: for every pair of unbounded module complexes $P,Q$, integers $p,q,n$ with $p+q=n$ and $q+p=n$, site object $U$, and sections $x\in P^p(U)$, $y\in Q^q(U)$, one has $\beta_{P,Q}^n(\iota_{p,q}^n(x\otimes y))=(-1)^{pq}\iota_{q,p}^n(y\otimes x)$. This defines a predicate, without asserting it, and imposes no K-flatness, boundedness or characteristic condition.
